fields.name: published
fields.label: Publish this post
fields.description: Off = draft. Saving a published post commits to GitHub and appears publicly after the next successful hosting build.

fields.name: archived
fields.label: Archive this post
fields.description: Keeps the content file but removes the post from public pages and sitemaps after the next build. Add an appropriate redirect for an old indexed address.

fields.name: supportEmail
fields.label: Support email address
fields.description: Use one verified, monitored mailbox. Leave empty to hide the contact and footer email links. Do not add mailto:, a subject line or message headers.

fields.name: socialImage
fields.label: Default sharing image
fields.description: Use /opengraph-image or an existing local image path in /uploads/ or /blog/.

fields.name: sameAs
fields.label: Verified official profile URLs
fields.description: Optional HTTPS profiles that actually represent FileCompresser. Leave empty when none are verified.

fields.name: rules
fields.label: Permanent redirects
fields.description: After renaming or archiving an indexed article, add its old address and the final published replacement. Redirects become live after a successful hosting build. Do not redirect an address that still has a published page.

fields.name: from
fields.label: Old address
fields.description: An exact path such as /blog/old-guide. No domain, trailing slash, query, fragment or wildcard.

fields.name: to
fields.label: Published destination
fields.description: The final address of an existing published page or tool, such as /blog/new-guide or /image-compressor. External sites, drafts, redirect chains and loops are rejected by the build.
